guard.note: Tons Of Enchants 1.21.1-v1.0 for NeoForge: orechainMap = new HashMap<>() and excavatorMap = new HashMap<>() (public static final Map<Player, Boolean>), then processedBlocks and RANDOM
declared methods: inside PU only destroyOreVein and destroyBlocksCube touch the two maps
excavatorMap.put(player, true), the 3 x 3 x 3 destroyBlock walk, excavatorMap.put(player, false)
orechainMap.getOrDefault(player, false) guard, put(player, true), the vein walk, put(player, false) on both exits
PU.excavatorMap.getOrDefault(the breaking player, false) before destroyBlocksCube (BreakEvent: server only)
PU.orechainMap.getOrDefault(the breaking player, false) before destroyOreVein (BreakEvent: server only)
equal = same entity id: a respawned player equals its predecessor
remove (logout, server stop): removal reason UNLOADED_WITH_PLAYER
respawn: the old player removed with the given reason (not UNLOADED_WITH_PLAYER), the new one gets its id

stale_player_map_purge_tonsofenchants.conversion: Fix: @Inject at RETURN of PU.<clinit> (@Shadow of its static excavatorMap and orechainMap) hands both maps to the shared stale-player-map layer bons.furious.patch.stale_player_maps.StalePlayerKeys as server ID maps, bound by name through a MethodHandle (helper bons.furious.patch.stale_player_maps_toe.ToeMaps); the layer's listeners swap a respawned player's key and purge at logout
